cohort: 14,207 very low birth weight infants (<1500 g) admitted to NICUs in the Canadian Neonatal Network between 2010-2016 without culture-proven sepsis in the first week of life
finding: Prolonged empirical antibiotic exposure (4-7 days) within the first week of life was associated with increased odds of a composite outcome of mortality or major morbidity in very low birth weight infants.
